changelog:
OpenClaw Telegram Setup – Initial Release

- Provides step-by-step guide for configuring Telegram Bot as a message channel in OpenClaw.
- Supports both personal and group chat integration via allowedChatIds.
- Includes command customization and webhook setup instructions.
- Addresses common troubleshooting questions.
- Lists contact options for free setup assistance.
summary: Configure a Telegram Bot with OpenClaw in 10 minutes to enable free, worldwide AI messaging with command, group, and webhook support.
